name: What are common elements included in a bathroom refresh project?

mainEntity.name: What are common elements included in a bathroom refresh project?

acceptedAnswer.text: A bathroom refresh typically includes cosmetic upgrades such as painting walls, updating lighting fixtures, replacing the vanity and countertop, installing a new toilet, and upgrading faucets or showerheads. It can also involve minor tile work, such as replacing a backsplash or re-grouting existing tiles. The goal is to achieve a fresh, updated look without altering the room's footprint.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common elements include painting, updating lights, replacing vanity, toilet, faucets, and minor tile work to enhance aesthetics.
